summary: Alerts from the weekday scan of X (every 5 minutes, 10:00 am to 6:00 pm Singapore time), as of Fri 30 Oct 2026, 3:41 pm. Event time is when the incident happened, which can differ from when it was reported; it says not stated when sources don't give it.

netRead.lead: Net read: supply risk is rising.
netRead.text: Six of ten alerts point to higher prices, centered on the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi Arabia, plus a tighter diesel market as Russia extends its export ban. A US offer of direct talks with Iran and a 40 million barrel US SPR loan are the offsets, but Tehran hasn't answered and rejected Qatar's plan.
